import sys, json, numpy as np
sys.path.insert(0, '/opt/tools')
from rcb_client import Robot

r=Robot(); spec=r.spec(); dt=spec['control_dt']; cams=list(spec['cameras'])

def move_to(xyz, grip=-1.0, speed=0.7, cameras=('topview','front')):
    obs=r.get_obs(cameras=cameras, include_depth=False)
    layout=obs.meta['proprio']['layout']; p=dict(zip(layout,obs.meta['proprio']['now']))
    start=np.array([p['mocap_x'],p['mocap_y'],p['mocap_z']],float)
    delta=np.asarray(xyz,float)-start
    n=max(1,int(np.ceil(np.max(np.abs(delta))/(0.01*speed))))
    a=np.tile(np.r_[delta/(n*0.01),grip],(n,1))
    result=r.submit('ee_delta',a,dt=dt,cameras=cameras,include_depth=True,video='frames')
    q=dict(zip(layout,result.meta['proprio']['now']))
    print('move',start,'->',xyz,'steps',n,'tcp',[q[k] for k in ('tcp_x','tcp_y','tcp_z')], 'left',result.meta['time_left_s'],flush=True)
    return result

if __name__=='__main__':
    result=move_to((-0.06,0.60,0.33),-1,0.8,cameras=cams)
    result.save('/app/runs/lift')
